outcome: incidence of brachial plexus birth palsy (BPBP)
cohort: The study included 76,000 livebirths at a single institution between 2011 and 2015.
finding: The incidence of brachial plexus birth palsy (BPBP) was 0.13%, with shoulder dystocia and right-sided palsy being predictors of a longer recovery course.
